comply-in.span: Processes text, images, and audio in one model for coherent understanding.
Connects information across different modalities for richer answers.
Accepts any combination of text, image, or audio queries.
Train on diverse data; model adapts without starting from scratch.

p: Multimodal AI is a machine learning architecture that simultaneously processes and integrates multiple data modalities—such as text, images, and audio—by encoding them into a shared embedding space, enabling the model to reason across modalities and generate outputs that leverage combined context, without requiring separate models for each input type.

sec-head.p: The pipeline that processes and integrates multiple modalities in a unified model.

card.p: A user provides text, image, or audio input.
Each modality is converted into numerical embeddings.
The embeddings are combined into a shared representation.
The model analyzes the combined data for context.
The model produces a response leveraging all modalities.
